title: Bill To block shows the customer name and address
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists for a customer that has a company name (or personal name) and a full address.
steps:
1. Generate the Estimate or Invoice.
2. Look at the addresses area.
expected:
1. A block labeled exactly "Bill To" is shown.
2. It shows the customer's name — the company name when the customer has one, otherwise the customer's personal name.
3. It shows the customer's street address, city, state or province, and postal code.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9141 (Story 2, Addresses) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, section S2-R1, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Remit Payment To shows when a payee is configured (both mechanisms)
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a document whose shop uses integrated-billing remit-to, and another whose location has its own remit-to setting (remit to another location or a custom address).
steps:
1. Generate an Estimate or Invoice where the shop's integrated-billing remit-to is configured; look at the addresses area.
2. Generate an Estimate or Invoice where the location's own remit-to setting is configured; look at the addresses area.
expected:
1. A block labeled exactly "Remit Payment To" is shown, holding the payee address.
2. The payee resolves from either mechanism: the shop's integrated-billing remit-to, or the location's own remit-to setting.
3. The block appears on the Estimate and Invoice (not on the Credit Invoice).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9141 (Story 2, Addresses) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, section S2-R2, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Bill To spans full width when Remit Payment To is absent
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a document that has no remit-to payee configured (neither mechanism).
steps:
1. Generate an Estimate or Invoice with no remit-to payee configured.
2. Look at the addresses area and note the width of the Bill To block.
3. For comparison, generate a document that does have a remit-to payee.
expected:
1. When there is no Remit Payment To block, the Bill To block spans the full width of the addresses area (it does not stay at half width).
2. When a Remit Payment To block is present, Bill To and Remit Payment To sit side by side.
3. On the Credit Invoice, where Remit Payment To never appears, the Credit To block is always full width.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9141 (Story 2, Addresses) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, section S2-R3, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Remit Payment To is hidden when no payee is configured
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a document whose shop has neither integrated-billing remit-to nor a location remit-to setting configured.
steps:
1. Generate an Estimate or Invoice with no remit-to payee configured.
2. Look at the addresses area.
expected:
1. No "Remit Payment To" block is shown.
2. The shop's own address is NOT printed as a fallback remit-to (this fallback has been removed).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9141 (Story 2, Addresses) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, sections S2-N2 and S2-R2, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Bill To address fields hide when empty; the name line always shows
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a document for a customer missing one or more of: street address, city, state or province, postal code.
steps:
1. Generate an Estimate or Invoice for a customer missing one or more Bill To address fields.
2. Look at the Bill To block.
expected:
1. Each missing field among the street address, city, state or province, and postal code is hidden — no blank line is left.
2. The name line is always shown, even when the address fields are empty.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9141 (Story 2, Addresses) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, section S2-N1, read on 25 August 2026.
